title: E2E Performance Benchmark Manifest V2
description: Issue #2422: immutable manifest produced by scripts/ci/collect_e2e_performance_benchmark.py's bounded orchestrator for a frozen-source-SHA `benchmark_layout=monolith|split` A/B/A/B dispatch experiment. Supersedes `e2e_performance_benchmark_manifest_v1`'s `before_sha`/`after_sha`/`pre_split`/`post_split` hybrid semantics (a fixed historical commit compared against a mutable current workflow) with a single frozen source SHA compared across the `benchmark_layout` treatment ONLY. The dispatch root run set (`blocks[].runs[]`) is fixed at dispatch time and is never filtered by outcome (Issue #2422 AC6) -- a `conclusion` other than `success` is recorded, not silently dropped or replaced by an additional dispatch.

experiment_identity.description: Free-form stable identifier for this dispatch root run set (operator bookkeeping).

experiment_run_set_digest.description: Issue #2422 AC5: deterministic digest of the canonicalized (block_id, benchmark_layout, workflow_run_id, run_attempt) tuple set for EVERY run in `blocks[].runs[]`, sorted for input-order independence, via json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) then sha256. Outcome (conclusion) is NEVER an input -- this digest identifies the frozen root run set regardless of which runs succeeded or failed.

frozen_source_sha.description: The single frozen application-code commit SHA measured by BOTH benchmark_layout arms (monolith and split) -- distinct from `workflow_sha` below. Both arms measure the SAME commit; only `benchmark_layout` (the provider job topology) is the treatment.

workflow_sha.description: Commit SHA of the WORKFLOW DEFINITION (`github.workflow_sha`) shared by every run in this manifest -- required-equal across every block/run/arm (Issue #2422 AC1/AC3).

workflow_digest.description: Issue #2422 AC1/AC3: content digest of `.github/workflows/ci.yml` AT the commit `workflow_sha` points to, computed from that commit's own bytes (e.g. via the GitHub Contents API) -- NEVER a sha256sum of a post-checkout local working-tree file, which could silently diverge from the commit `workflow_sha` claims. Required-equal across every block/run/arm.

FrozenNonTreatment.description: Issue #2422 Outcome/AC1/AC5: the non-treatment fingerprint that must be identical across BOTH benchmark_layout arms -- only `benchmark_layout` (topology) is the treatment.

test_inventory_digest.description: Digest identifying the exact frozen Playwright test file inventory measured by both arms.

expected_playwright_invocations.description: Issue #2422 fix_delta Blocker 4 (OWNER REQUEST_CHANGES on PR #2501, issuecomment-5549966497): a LIST of distinct, identifiable Playwright invocations (never a bare test-count integer -- #2424's reliability projection needs to bind per-lane invocation identity, provider placement, and evidence-file correspondence, none of which a plain count can express). This Issue defines the PRODUCER CONTRACT (schema/shape) only -- wiring an actual JSON reporter's output into this array is #2424's responsibility (never pre-implemented here). See `expected_test_count` below for a plain aggregate count, kept separate from invocation identity.

expected_test_count.description: Issue #2422 fix_delta Blocker 4: OPTIONAL plain aggregate Playwright test-case count, kept separate from `expected_playwright_invocations`' per-invocation identity list (a consumer that only needs a drift-detection count, not per-lane binding, reads this field instead).

toolchain_digest.description: Combined Node/pnpm/Playwright toolchain fingerprint digest shared by both arms.

ExpectedPlaywrightInvocation.description: Issue #2422 fix_delta Blocker 4: identifies ONE distinct Playwright invocation the frozen non-treatment fingerprint expects -- `invocation_id`/`lane` are the LOGICAL identity (stable across `benchmark_layout` arms), `provider_placement` is the (arm-dependent) PHYSICAL provider job each arm runs it in -- kept separate because monolith runs both lanes sequentially inside `e2e-core` while split runs them as two parallel provider jobs, without changing invocation identity. `evidence_file` names the artifact path this invocation's evidence is expected under. This schema entry defines the PRODUCER CONTRACT shape only -- actual JSON-reporter wiring (Playwright execution + evidence file generation) is #2424's responsibility, never pre-implemented by this Issue.

invocation_id.description: Stable identifier for this invocation, unique within `expected_playwright_invocations`.

evidence_file.description: Artifact-relative path this invocation's evidence (e.g. a JSON reporter output or a runtime-evidence file) is expected under.

LayoutProviderPlacement.description: Issue #2422 fix_delta Blocker 4: maps each `benchmark_layout` arm to the provider job name that physically executes this invocation's lane in that arm -- e.g. `monolith` places BOTH `core` and `responsive` lane invocations under `e2e-core` (sequential, single provider), while `split` places them under `e2e-core`/`e2e-responsive-matrix` respectively (parallel, two providers). Required for both arms so a consumer can bind evidence regardless of which arm produced it.

Block.description: Issue #2422 AC3/AC7: one matched (monolith, split) pair dispatched in that fixed order -- `block_id` ties the two runs together across the A/B/A/B sequence.

conclusion.description: Issue #2422 AC6: recorded as observed, never filtered/excluded from the manifest -- the root run set is fixed at dispatch time regardless of outcome.

run_url.description: Issue #2422 AC7: captured from the workflow dispatch API's `return_run_details: true` response at dispatch time -- never inferred post-hoc via `gh run list`.

job_names_started.description: Issue #2422 AC7/AC8: the full set of job names that actually started for this run -- evidence that only measured provider jobs plus the minimal gate-ready job started (no typecheck/lint/build/etc. unrelated jobs).

provider_jobs.description: Issue #2422 fix_delta Blocker 6: a run's dispatch always starts at least one measured provider job -- an EMPTY array here (e.g. a `success` conclusion with zero recorded provider-job evidence) is a structural, schema-level fail-closed rejection. Layout-specific minimum composition (monolith needs `e2e-core`; split needs `e2e-core`+`e2e-responsive-matrix`) and the global `workflow_run_id` uniqueness invariant are cross-field checks the schema cannot express -- see `verify_required_provider_jobs_present_for_layout`/`verify_workflow_run_id_global_uniqueness` in scripts/ci/collect_e2e_performance_benchmark.py.

ExactRunnerImage.description: Issue #2422 AC4: job-level (workflow_job_id + that job's OWN `Set up job` log section) exact Runner Image identity -- never a run-level representative value, never sourced from a different probe job, never OS/architecture only, never `unknown`/empty.
